reviews.text: Fab staff and great care to all pets👍 …

Exceptional high quality empathic veterinary care. Emily has looked after 3 of my dogs with the highest standard of care and kindness and am so thankful for her holistic knowledge and diagnosis. My last dog had many problems and developed Cushings disease at age 9 and was unresponsive to medical treatment and Emily prescribed homeopathic remedies which gave him great comfort easing his breathing and fear in the last few months of his life. He passed away peacefully in ease and  that is a greatest comfort forl the family and we are all very grateful.

The whole team at Portmarnock are wonderful. We’ve had them care for both our Senior and Puppy Staffies, and they were excellent with each! So caring and compassionate in every situation - especially end of life care. We can never thank them enough for looking after our Rebel in his final days. Riot absolutely LOVES going to the vets and will want to call in just to say hi - that’s how good they are!
Highly recommend them.

We have been visiting Portmarnock Vets with our 3.5 year old dog since she was a puppy. She has had her fair share of ailments and the team have always taken the best care of her with plenty of cuddles and treats. Prices are reasonable and they are always upfront about any large expense we may incur. Sally loves going in there which is quite the compliment in itself!

Emily, Alison and the nurses are an amazing team! Our dog Roxy had to get local anasthesia surgery and Alison was incredible! They nurses called the day after surgery to check up on our dog Roxy and also immediately made follow up appointments and we were even able to get a holostic remedy for after surgery care from Vet Emily.

The team takes their time and they do not rush the appointments at all. We love that we are able to take a holistic approach with our dogs knee pain with Vet Emily who has helped our dog greatly! It is worth the 2 hour car ride everytime. Truly the best vets in Ireland! Thank you very much team
First class care for both our cats , one who passed away recently, we and the cat were treated with tenderness compassion and care
Very pleasant experience. We brought our dog Max to get his eye infection checked. The vet was very thorough with him and informative. We will be returning if Max ever requires further treatment.

A terrible experience from start to finish. Aside from routine visits, we used this practice twice for specific procedures, and each time the invoice was nearly double the initial quote although there were no complications. I have no doubt this practice is loading invoices, particularly if the pet has health insurance. They also take an age to submit claims. When we questioned the second overcharge, the owner phoned and engaged in gaslighting and deflection. We were told that independent practices were struggling to survive and we were extremely unfair to question the invoice. On our last visit, a nurse falsely claimed the Veterinary Council of Ireland (VCI) rules changed on 1 Jan 2026, so she couldn’t sell Simparica tablets without an €80 six-month check-up to get a valid prescription. Our dog wasn’t due an annual visit until July. I wrote to the VCI to ask about the new policy and they replied to say there had been no policy change. I forwarded their reply to the practice. The owner was angry that I had contacted the VCI, confirmed I had been lied to, and then reverted to her previous playbook. She concluded by telling me to take our dog elsewhere. This is a badly run, money grabbing operation, and we have reported our concerns to the VCI and dog insurer. Avoid.
Emma is very helpful. Thank you
When needed help you were there. Thank you Emma

Just had another thorough check up for my mini Schauzer, Jessie.  We've been using Portmarnock Vets for 4 years now, since she was a puppy. I love their holistic approach. They don't push unnecessary vaccinations or too many booster shots, and are fans of the titre testing whereby they will test your dog's level of antibodies first to see if they actually need further vaccination boosters.  Jessie was also neutered here, and the whole process went perfectly. They also provide non-toxic natural remedies wherever possible for certain common ailments. I live in central Dublin, so yes, it is a bit of a trek to drive out to Portmarnock, but it's well worth it to get the best care. Highly recommend!

Brought my precious dog here three years ago as we were looking for a naturopath who would also be a qualified and experienced veterinarian. The experience has exceeded  our expectations and we haven't regretted the decision .

I have been a client with this clinic for 5 years.  I recently brought my dog there for a consultation regarding dental treatment.  I was quoted €865 plus possible extras for grade 2 plaque removal under aesthetic.  I in addition paid for the consultation. The vet was to get back to me regarding a 2 step payment plan as this procedure was not covered under my insurance.
They never got back to me.
Please note I had the very same procedure carried out today by another highly professional  local veterinary clinic for €425.
Needless to say I will not be using this clinic again in the future. Anne-Marie

Incredible impressed with the care and attention at Portmarnock Vet Clinic. The team are kind, attentive and skilled. They have supported us in every day and emergency matters with a calm & steady manner. Grateful for this practice.

I would give a higher rating if I could. The care and attention received at Portmarnock Veterinary Clinic was excellent. Fiona was able to make this the most stress-free vet visit my cat has ever had, without needing to sedate her, which I haven't experienced elsewhere, and she thoroughly discussed the options for my cat's complicated case. Thank you so much.
These vet has knowledge...

What a super Vet practice. They looked after my dog so well despite us not being clients as we were visiting home and needed to get seen to after an emergency. So kind, attentive, really provided excellent care. Thank you so much.

I travelled an hour to go here and I am so glad I did. Sally is excellent, taking everything into consideration. Ive used homeopathy myself with great success, so I love and appreciate the holistic approach. I only wish there were more taking this approach.
Unfortunately my local vet offered a medicated approach only, which was making things worse and putting our dog in a cycle of costly medication but not actually solving the root of the issue. I am very grateful to have a car to be able to get here and then enjoy the beach walk after. Thanks again Sally & we look forward to seeing u again soon. Sinead & Jack

Emily is a wonderful and caring vet. She has been there for my Dogs from cradle to grave for nearly 20 years.

The telephone homeopathic consults are an excellent addition to the practice.
Friendly helpful staff and great service.

My Dog was having some skin & Ear issues so a few people recommended this holistic vet,so I thought I’d ring them and explain my situation.I told her about my dog's issues over the phone thinking she would be like oh bring him in I’ll take …
Emily and all the team take such great care with my elderly cavalier. He's been attending them for the last 8 years. He's now 12 and still going strong. Thanks

Wonderful vets. It's great to see a practice utilising homeopathic and other natural remedies. Emily gave me three remedies for my dog, which helped ease horrible symptoms of a serious illness. Thank you for everything you did for my girl Zuri. I'll be forever grateful. ❤️
Brilliant vets. Highly recommend
